title: The Fixer's Price
summary: The Fixer is gone, and so is half the strongbox. He left a letter: the Watch offered him a clean name for yours, and he took it. He's hiding with hired crossbows at a pillager outpost until the Watch comes to collect him. Get there first. Then decide what a man like that is worth.

goals.say: He doesn't run. 'I'd have done the same to you,' he says. 'You know I would. You'd have done it first, if you'd thought of it.'

threats.name: The Fixer
talk: Because the Watch was coming for one of us, and I've always liked me better. Nothing personal.
You built it on my name and my buyers. I just took my half back early.
No they fucking won't. I'm a witness now. Witnesses get to live. Ask Pell. Oh. Right.

spare.label: Let him run to the Watch
spare.line: He backs away, then runs, and doesn't look back. He'll tell them everything. He was always good at talking.

quest_book.title: Nothing Personal
quest_book.author: The Fixer
pages:
You'll have noticed the strongbox.

I took my half. Call it a finder's fee: I found you, after all.
The Watch came to me last week. They know everything except your name, and they offered me my whole life back for it. A clean name. No more looking over my shoulder.

I said yes. Of course I said yes. You'd have said yes.

Nothing personal. It never was.

- F.

dialogue.reward: The outpost is quiet. Somewhere, the Watch is writing your name down anyway.
